dedupe_keys.name: ireland fire service statistics 2016 station turnouts and operational work of fire brigades

description: These tables give a national picture of the work of Ireland's fire brigades in 2016: how many times each fire station and fire authority turned out to fires, special service incidents and false alarms, and what kinds of incidents they attended. The station table lists every fire station and post with its turnouts by category and ambulance turnouts; the authority tables add the number of stations and posts, and the operational work table splits special services into road traffic collisions, water pumping and flooding, water rescues, other rescues and hazardous substances, and false alarms into malicious and good intent calls. The producer is the Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage, whose National Directorate for Fire and Emergency Management supports local fire authorities. Coverage is all fire authorities in Ireland for the single year 2016, alongside companion tables on causes and locations of fires, prevention work and fire safety licences. The CSV files are free on data.gov.ie under CC BY-SA 4.0 and listed through its CKAN API. Caveats: only 2016 is published in this series, the files carry title rows and blank columns that need cleaning, and turnouts are annual counts without times or locations of incidents. Simulation uses: demand rates by station and incident type for fire service capacity and station coverage models, and the share of flooding and rescue work in emergency service load. Related records: the U.S. National Fire Incident Reporting System public release (data-usfa-nfirs-public-data-release) gives incident-level data for comparison.
